title: Existence of an augmented flat-pushforward resolution lift
statement: For f:X→S and g:S′→S with g′=pullback.snd g f flat, F an O_X-module and injective resolutions I of F and J of g′^*F, there exists a chain map t:I→g′_*J with I.ι⁰ t⁰ = η_F g′_*(J.ι⁰). [def-sp-injective-resolutions] [def-pc-module-pullback] [lem-weil-pbc-flat-module-pullback-exact-pushforward-injective]

proof.text: Pushforward along g′ preserves injectives by flatness. Extend the unit followed by g′_*(J.ι⁰) across the monomorphism I.ι⁰ into the injective object g′_*(J⁰), obtaining z. The composite z d vanishes on F because J.ι⁰ d=0. Use I.exact₀.descToInjective to extend z d across I.d⁰, obtaining degree one. Inductively I.exact_succ n extends each next composite across the next differential: the previous chain-map equation and d²=0 give the necessary vanishing. CochainComplex.mkHom assembles the components; mkHom_f_0 gives the prescribed augmentation.

lean.statement:
theorem flatBaseChangeResolutionLift {X S S' : Scheme.{uBC}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S) [Flat (pullback.snd g f)]
    {F : X.Modules} (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F)) :
    ∃ t : I.cocomplex ⟶ ((pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex,
      I.ι.f 0 ≫ t.f 0 =
        (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd g f))).unit.app F ≫
          (pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).map (J.ι.f 0)
